localBiteReport: The most recent angler reports from Choctawhatchee Bay (week of November 12–19, 2026) confirm redfish as the standout inshore species, with a charter trip this week landing a pair of solid keeper reds around bridge and dock structure. Half Hitch's current November forecast for the Destin/Choctawhatchee Bay area describes this month as prime time for flounder, redfish, and speckled trout: rat reds are holding on docks and bridges, bull reds are schooling in the pass and on the flats, and trout are working topwater lures on the grass flats. Flounder are also highlighted as a top November target, with some of the best action of the year expected in the bays. Sheepshead should be picking up around bridge pilings and jetties as water temperatures continue to cool toward the 70°F range.
